verdict.rationale: Clerky's own docs show that signing is built into its workflow: users "sign documents on Clerky", document sets bundle signatures, and "Clerky handles signing." Nothing shows a founder sending an arbitrary document to several signers, configuring signing order or routing, or any statement about legal-binding status. Collaboration and task-assignment features are adjacent and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: multi-recipient send, signing order/routing configuration, evidence of legally binding e-signature compliance, sending arbitrary uploaded documents, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can send a document for legally binding e-signature to multiple recipients with routing

citations.quote: Users enter formation information in your product and sign documents on Clerky.
Clerky handles signing and formation work.
